title: Securities Trading Policy
date_effective: Upon admission of the Company on the Australian Securities Exchange

tiers.name: Restricted Persons
tiers.description: All Directors including the CEO, all other key management personnel of the Company, and employees who have been notified that they are Restricted Persons. Subject to prior clearance, annual/half-year blackout periods, discouragement of short-term/speculative trading, and outright bans on short-selling and on hedging, with margin lending/secured financing permitted only with the Chairman's (or Board's) prior approval.

tiers.name: Chairman of the Board
tiers.description: The Chairman, a Restricted Person distinguished only for clearance and secured-financing approval: consent must come from the Board rather than the Chairman or a delegate.

tiers.name: Directors
tiers.description: Directors of the Company, distinguished only for the post-trade requirement to provide the Company Secretary with information sufficient to notify ASX of a change of interests.

tiers.name: employees and contractors
tiers.description: Directors, employees and contractors who are not Restricted Persons. Subject only to the general insider trading prohibition; the clearance, blackout period, short-term dealing, short-selling and hedging/secured financing restrictions in section 6 do not apply to this tier.

tiers.name: Closely Connected Persons
tiers.description: A close family member (spouse or de facto, minor children or children living with the Restricted Person) or a closely connected entity (family company or family trust that the Restricted Person or close family members may control or have an interest in) of a Restricted Person.

rules.detail: 'Securities' is expressly defined to include options, warrant contracts and other derivatives relating to the shares, with no venue limitation, so an OTC put or call is 'dealing in Company Securities' requiring prior notification and Company Secretary/Chairman confirmation, and cannot occur during blackout periods. A derivative designed to hedge exposure is separately and absolutely banned under 6.11 regardless of clearance.

exemption_authority: The person specified in section 7 (Chairman of the Board, or delegate; the Board if the Restricted Person is the Chairman) may grant a written waiver, without giving reasons, from the blackout-period restriction (6.5(b)) or the short-term/speculative dealing restriction (6.6(a)) only, valid for 5 business days, on evidence of severe financial hardship, a court order, or other deemed-exceptional circumstances and that the dealing is the most reasonable course of action available; a granted waiver can be withdrawn if new circumstances arise, and a refusal must be kept confidential by the Restricted Person. This waiver power does not extend to the hedging or short-selling bans in section 6.11.

bespoke_clauses.topic: hedging ban has no waiver route
bespoke_clauses.clause: the Restricted Person must apply to the person specified in section 7 for a waiver from compliance with the provisions in sections 6.5(b) or 6.6(a).
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The exceptional-circumstances waiver mechanism covers only the blackout-period and short-term dealing rules, not the absolute hedging ban in section 6.11, so there is no waiver route at all for a collar structured as a hedge.

bespoke_clauses.clause: where a Restricted Person has been granted approval to enter into margin lending or other secured financing arrangement (refer section 6.11), an involuntary disposal of securities that result from the margin lender or financier exercising its rights under the arrangement.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: If the Chairman (or Board, for the Chairman) approves the loan under 6.11, a subsequent forced sale by the bank on default is expressly excepted from the blackout-period restriction, giving the bank a clean enforcement path once the initial approval is obtained.

bespoke_clauses.topic: Chairman's approval routed to the Board
bespoke_clauses.clause: Chairman of the Board | The Board
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: If the Chairman personally wants a funded collar, approval authority for the loan shifts from the Chairman/delegate to the full Board, a materially higher bar than for other Restricted Persons.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Each Restricted Person must ensure that any trading by their Closely Connected Persons are undertaken in accordance with this Policy.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A collar or secured loan cannot be routed through a spouse, minor child, or family trust/company to avoid the hedging ban or the secured-financing approval requirement.

summary: A funded collar is effectively blocked for Restricted Persons (Directors, other KMP, and notified employees) of 4DMedical. Section 6.11 imposes an absolute ban on 'transactions designed to hedge their exposure to Company Securities', squarely covering a purchased put or a collar, and the exceptional-circumstances waiver in section 6.9 applies only to the blackout-period rule and the short-term dealing rule, not to the hedging ban, so no waiver mechanism is available for it at all. The loan leg is only conditionally restricted: a margin loan or other secured financing arrangement over Company Securities requires the Chairman's (or delegate's) prior approval, or the Board's if the Restricted Person is the Chairman, and once approved, a lender's subsequent enforcement sale is expressly excepted from the blackout-period restriction. Even setting the hedging ban aside, any derivative dealing (Securities is defined to include options and other derivatives) needs prior notification and Company Secretary/Chairman confirmation, cannot occur during the annual or half-year blackout periods, and is discouraged if the position is held six months or less. Closely Connected Persons (spouse, minor children, family trust or company) are bound by the same restrictions, so the structure cannot be routed around the hedging ban through them. Overall, the secured loan could in principle be approved but the put and call legs cannot, making a funded collar with a bank unavailable to Restricted Persons as drafted.
